t1 requirements COMPLETED (verdict=pass). Report: trading_live/research/inspect_popup_fix_requirements.md.

Both root causes confirmed with offscreen probes:
1. Chart (chart_widget.py:101-105): y-range is direction-asymmetric — lo gets only stop, hi gets only entry+TP (BUY geometry). For SELL signals the excluded side renders off-plot and vanishes: probe showed SL at -14.9px (SELL, price below entry) and entry 230.7px + TP 292.8px on a 220px widget (SELL, price above entry). Also: label clipping at plot edge and zero/None degeneracy (missing SL -> 0.0 pulls lo to 0.0). Fix spec: guard v>0, symmetric all-level range, 8% span padding, label safety; optional non-blocking enhancement = anchor candle window to entry bar (limit=200 slice).
2. Entry time (signal_polling_engine_v2.py:517-528): PendingSignal.timestamp=time.time() = scan/found moment; SignalCandidate.entry_time (signal_engine_v2.py:451, entry-bar open) is dropped and never reaches state/GUI. Fix spec: trailing PendingSignal.entry_time=0.0 (epoch via _to_epoch), snapshot serialization, GUI table col0 + dialog 'Entry Time:' row with labeled '— (not recorded)' fallback; timestamp keeps driving the 1h stale guard unchanged.

t2 is now unlockable — the report is implementable without further investigation; verification commands for t2/t3 are in the report.

t2 (implementation) COMPLETED ✅ — both fixes implemented + verified headless, ready for t3 QA review.

What changed (4 inScope files):
1. trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py — Fix 1: paintEvent now includes ALL valid levels (entry/stop/TP, guarded v>0) in both ends of the price range (fixes SELL geometry where old code excluded SL from hi or entry/TP from lo), adds 8% vertical padding (min 0.5) with span re-derived after padding so outermost markers + labels stay inside the plot, and excludes 0.0/None levels from range AND drawing (no more scale collapse when SL/TP missing). Entry line at pen width 2. set_data/set_loading API unchanged.
2. trading_live/live/state/shared_app_state_v2.py — Fix 2: PendingSignal gains trailing entry_time: float = 0.0 (0.0 = not recorded, positional-compatible); snapshot serialized with "entry_time".
3. trading_live/live/engine/signal_polling_engine_v2.py — Fix 2: new _to_epoch(dt) helper (naive dt → local epoch, 0.0 on failure); _process_candidate now passes entry_time=_to_epoch(cand.entry_time).
4. trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py — Fix 2 display: table col0 header "Entry Time", cell shows fmt_time(entry_time) with tooltip "Entry time: … | Found at: …"; absent entry_time → graceful fallback to found time with "— (not recorded)" label; dialog gets "Entry Time:" row (fallback "— (not recorded)") and "Age (since found):"; timestamp untouched → 1h stale guard (table-agnostic, dialog + _on_send_order) preserved exactly. Optional enhancement from t1 applied: dialog fetches limit=200 and _on_candles_ready slices from the entry bar when it's inside the frame (pure pandas, GUI-thread-safe, still async via _InspectLoadWorker).

Verification (all in /tmp/ptv2_venv, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, exit 0):
- py_compile on all 4 files (bytecode cache redirected via PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX — sandbox blocks ~/Library/Caches writes).
- /tmp/chart_probe_t2.py — 6 scenarios (BUY/SELL far above/below × normal + zero-levels) against the real paintEvent path: every marker y inside plot rect [7.5,202.5]; zero-level keeps sane scale. PNG artifacts: trading_live/research/chart_fix_probe_C.png + chart_fix_probe_F.png.
- /tmp/entry_time_sanity_t2.py — dataclass round-trip, default 0.0, _to_epoch conversions, real _process_candidate → snapshot carries entry_time; timestamp stays the found moment.
- /tmp/gui_display_smoke_t2.py — table col0 + dialog render entry time & fallback; Send Order stays enabled for fresh signal.

No other files touched; constraints honored (no new deps, no GUI-thread MCP, RLock paths unchanged).

QA review t3 COMPLETE → verdict: needs_revision (1 finding). Evidence artifacts in trading_live/research/qa_probes/ (qa_chart_probe.py, qa_entry_time_probe.py, qa_gui_smoke.py, qa_labels_dialog_size.png, qa_labels_560.png).

PASSED (all independently verified):
• Chart fix holds: all 3 marker lines inside plot rect for BUY+SELL far-moved (9 scenarios), zero/None levels no degeneration, entry line width-2 on-canvas (pixel-verified), rows 0–4 clean (padding works), no crash.
• Entry-time fix holds end-to-end: SignalCandidate.entry_time → _to_epoch → PendingSignal → snapshot → table col0 "Entry Time" + dialog "Entry Time:" row, labeled "— (not recorded)" fallback + tooltip; 14/14 flow checks.
• Stale guard untouched: timestamp still drives MAX_MANUAL_SIGNAL_AGE_S in BOTH _on_send_order and dialog (proven: old timestamp + fresh entry_time disables Send Order).
• No regressions: send-order path & lot handling, positions P/L ($), stats refresh, async _InspectLoadWorker (fetch+risk-lot called off-thread), scope confined (no execution_layer/risk_guard/mt5), py_compile clean on all 7 touched files.

FAILED (1 acceptance item): chart_widget.py:184 — labels are left-anchored at x=plot_right−4 and grow past the widget's right edge; at the real dialog chart size (538×190, measured in-situ) "Stop Loss"/"Take Profit"/"Entry" render only their first ~10px (pixel evidence: label ink only at x∈[528,537]). Pre-existing cosmetic truncation, but t1's acceptance requires "labels inside the widget". Required fix (3 lines, no API change): right-align label text to the plot edge — drawText into QRect(pad_left, my-4, plot_w, 16) with AlignRight|AlignTop, or x = plot_right − 4 − QFontMetrics.horizontalAdvance(label).

t4 (repair round 2) COMPLETED ✅ — label clipping at the widget's right edge fixed, verified headless, ready for next QA review round.

Fix (trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py only, no API change):
- Root cause: _marker drew the label left-anchored at `drawText(int(pad_left + plot_w - 4), int(my - 4), label)` — text extended RIGHTWARD ~70px past the widget edge for long labels ('Take Profit' / 'Stop Loss'), i.e. clipped off-widget.
- Fix: label now renders into a right-aligned rect — `QRect(int(pad_left), int(my - 4), int(plot_w), 16)` with `Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop` (plus `QRect` added to the QtCore import). Labels grow leftward from the plot's right edge and always stay fully on-widget. _marker signature, set_data/set_loading API, and all call sites unchanged.

Verification (all exit 0, /tmp/ptv2_venv, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen):
1. py_compile live/gui/chart_widget.py — OK.
2. /tmp/chart_probe_t2.py — all 6 scenarios (BUY/SELL far above/below, normal, zero-levels) still pass the marker-y-inside-plot-rect assertions, PLUS new font-metric label-bounds assertions: every label's right edge = pad_left+plot_w ≤ widget width and left edge ≥ 0 — CHART_PROBE_OK.
3. /tmp/entry_time_sanity_t2.py — ENTRY_TIME_SANITY_OK (Fix 2 unchanged, regression check).
4. /tmp/gui_display_smoke_t2.py — GUI_DISPLAY_SMOKE_OK (table + dialog unaffected).

Changed paths: trading_live/live/gui/chart_widget.py only. No other file touched; no new deps; GUI-thread/RLock constraints unaffected.

Review round 2 COMPLETE → verdict PASS ✅ (t5 completed).

The round-1 finding (labels truncated at the widget's right edge) is verified FIXED by t4. My own re-verification, not t2/t4's claims:
• Pixel + font-metric evidence at the REAL dialog chart size (538×190, measured in-situ): labels now right-aligned and fully on-widget — Stop Loss spans 474..532 (was a 528..537 sliver), Take Profit 470..532, Entry 501..532; SL label ink pixels x∈[6,531] confirmed via scan.
• CHART_PROBE_PASS 9/9 (BUY+SELL far-moved markers inside plot rect, zero/None no scale degeneracy, rows 0–4 clean, entry white line pixel-verified).
• ENTRY_TIME_PROBE_PASS 14/14 (entry_time end-to-end; timestamp still drives the 1h stale guard — fresh entry_time + old timestamp disables Send Order).
• GUI_SMOKE_PASS 18/18 (table col0 Entry Time + labeled fallback, dialog Entry Time row, positions P/L, stats refresh, async worker off-GUI-thread).
• py_compile clean on all 7 touched files; t4 scope = chart_widget.py only; no regressions.

Both reported defects (chart markers/SL-TP visibility + true entry-time display) are now fixed and QA-gated. Evidence artifacts in trading_live/research/qa_probes/.
